title: Finite-level affine comparison of formal kernel images and quotient submodules
statement:
theorem coherentFormalModule_affine_kernel_image_comparison
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    let A := Γ(X, U.1)
    let R := AdicCompletion (I.ideal U) A
    let J := (I.ideal U).map (algebraMap A R)
    ∃ (M N : ModuleCat.{u} R) (f : M ⟶ N),
      Module.Finite R M ∧ Module.Finite R N ∧
      ∀ (l k m : ℕ) (hl : m ≤ l) (hk : m ≤ k),
        (((J ^ (l + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule R N)).comap f.hom).map
            (J ^ (m + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule R M)).mkQ =
          ((J ^ (k + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule R N)).comap f.hom).map
            (J ^ (m + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule R M)).mkQ) ↔
        ∀ (W : X.Opens), W ≤ U.1 →
          Set.range ((Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫
            F.obj.map (homOfLE hl).op)).app W) =
          Set.range ((Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op k)) ≫
            F.obj.map (homOfLE hk).op)).app W)

source.place: Lemma 087X, proof of claim (a); Lemma 087W for affine comparison

proof.text: Restrict both coherent formal objects and their morphism to U. Transport across U = Spec Gamma(U,O_X) and use the affine formal-module equivalence to obtain finite completed modules M,N and f. The level projections are quotient projections modulo the extended ideal powers and commute with f and transitions.

Lifting through the level-l projection identifies the image of the reduced kernel in level m with the image of f inverse(J^(l+1)N) in M/J^(m+1)M. Kernels and images are quasi-coherent and their affine sections compute the linear kernels and images.

The affine tilde equivalence identifies these quotient submodule inclusions with the corresponding image subsheaf inclusions. Equal submodules yield equal subsheaves, hence equal section ranges on all W inside U. The converse follows by taking W=U and the same affine quotient identification.
